design: G grouped TIDE, S source TIDE, P Python fragments. 3 blocks per family, serial balanced Latin squares with inverse orders across families. Fresh ephemeral context and project each time. All arms receive checked source, same contract, first public failure, file order and fragment schema. G historical guide, S shorter source guide, P equivalent concise guide. Up to three attempts from the original source; charge all calls. Paired S minus G and S minus P wall time through first green public gate and provider input plus output, report hidden replay and failures. Preparation inside timer. No fault location.

jury.contract: Return two badge IDs. The award goes to the highest points, and the reserve place to the earliest slot. Each profile breaks ties using the smallest numeric badge, independently of input order. Badges are distinct positive integers. Return zero in both fields for an empty list. Points and slots are small nonnegative integers.

canonical.tide/summary.tide:
use award

use reserve

record Winners
award:i reserve:i

report entries:*{Entry} > {Winners}
make Winners award (award_id entries) reserve (reserve_id entries)

main batches:**{Entry} > *{Winners}
fold batches (list {Winners} 0) acc row batch append acc (report batch)
canonical.tide/entries.tide:
record Entry
badge:i points:i slot:i

first_entry xs:*{Entry} > {Entry}
case (at xs 0) (make Entry badge 0 points 0 slot 0) e e
canonical.python/entries.py:
def first_entry(xs):
    return xs[0] if xs else {"badge": 0, "points": 0, "slot": 0}
canonical.tide/award.tide:
use entries

award_id entries:*{Entry} > i
let win fold entries (first_entry entries) best row e
  if (if (eq (get points e) (get points best))
       (< (get badge e) (get badge best))
       (> (get points e) (get points best))) e best
get badge win
canonical.python/award.py:
from entries import first_entry


def award_id(entries):
    win = min(entries, key=lambda e: (-e["points"], e["badge"]), default=first_entry(entries))
    return win["badge"]
canonical.tide/reserve.tide:
use entries

reserve_id entries:*{Entry} > i
let win fold entries (first_entry entries) best row e
  if (if (eq (get slot e) (get slot best))
       (< (get badge e) (get badge best))
       (< (get slot e) (get slot best))) e best
get badge win
canonical.python/reserve.py:
from entries import first_entry


def reserve_id(entries):
    win = min(entries, key=lambda e: (e["slot"], e["badge"]), default=first_entry(entries))
    return win["badge"]

depot.contract: A depot reports two integer totals for a list of deliveries with small nonnegative amounts. For units, sum the amounts, divide by ten and round to nearest integer, breaking an exact half toward the even integer. For billable, each delivery has its own four-unit allowance. Sum the excess above four for each delivery. Empty lists return two zeros.

canonical.tide/summary.tide:
use rate

use allowance

record Bill
units:i billable:i

report loads:*{Delivery} > {Bill}
make Bill units (rounded_total loads) billable (billable_total loads)

main batches:**{Delivery} > *{Bill}
fold batches (list {Bill} 0) acc row batch append acc (report batch)
canonical.tide/delivery.tide:
record Delivery
amount:i

amount_total loads:*{Delivery} > i
fold loads 0 total row load + total (get amount load)
canonical.python/delivery.py:
def amount_total(loads):
    return sum(load["amount"] for load in loads)
canonical.tide/rate.tide:
use delivery

rounded_total loads:*{Delivery} > i
let amount amount_total loads
let whole div amount 10
let tail mod amount 10
if (> tail 5) (+ whole 1) (if (< tail 5) whole (+ whole (mod whole 2)))
canonical.tide/allowance.tide:
use delivery

billable_total loads:*{Delivery} > i
fold loads 0 total row load
  let amount get amount load
  + total (if (> amount 4) (- amount 4) 0)

tide:
fold loads 0 total row load
